sense: in a book or a reference work

terms.gloss: look up, search into (a reference, a word)
terms.grammar: verb, third conjugation, with in + acc. or an object
evidence: Cic. Leg. 1.1.4: inquīre in ea quae memoriae sunt prōdita (Lewis & Short)

phrases.english: I don’t know; let’s look it up online.

phrases.latin: Inquīre in interrēte quot annōs vīvant elephantī.
phrases.english: Look up online how long elephants live.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 341.
